title: A held-out case the lead acted on as a builder is replaced; the lead never changes the work
situation: The lead read the failing smoke of the replacement held-out agents 4 and made the fix itself, rather than through a builder given only the concept and the shortfall; the same failure also showed in visible agents 20, and the fix states kinds of decision, not the case.
decision: Held-out agents 4 counts as exposed: work changed by someone who has seen a held-out case can be shaped by it, however general the change reads, so it becomes visible and a cold replacement takes its place. The lead sees held-out cases to run judgment and never changes the work itself; a fix always goes through a builder given only the concept and the shortfall.
consequences: The illustrator writes the replacement; its checks are frozen red and it is smoked and batched before judgment runs again.
